title: Hearing on the city's progress on its 2026 Streets Plan
summary: The Council's Transportation Committee held an oversight hearing on the state of the Streets Plan, a law requiring the Department of Transportation to expand bike lanes, bus lanes and pedestrian safety infrastructure. The committee also reviewed several related bills covering solar crosswalks, bike parking, school-zone traffic calming, bilingual street signs, a ferry service study for Inwood, and sidewalk and roadway cafe rules. Reports show DOT has repeatedly missed legally mandated bus lane, bike lane, bus stop and transit signal priority benchmarks under the 2019 law, though it exceeded targets for intersection redesigns and accessible pedestrian signals.
